evidence.ambition: shot-08s: one flat 2D tile layer with flat fills and thin graphite edges plus two small count bars; by shot-20s it is still one flat layer with no lighting, depth or second rendering idea.
evidence.craft: shot-08s: warm cream, ochre and rust palette with clean thin edges, but the top-left bars and bottom-left caption sit on the tiles and lose legibility at full size; shot-20s shows the same overlap.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: warm ochre and rust Penrose kite-and-dart rosette on cream, a non-slop mathematical mechanism with no archive to compare; by shot-20s the palette and flat tile look stay unchanged.

pairwise_justification: No median archive exists yet for the last 30 nights, so no head-to-head comparison is possible.
